description: Implementation of TrialComparisonCertVerifier class for conducting certificate verification trials with primary and trial verifiers, including job management, verification process coordination, and result comparison.

classes.name: TrialComparisonCertVerifier::Job
classes.description: Represents a verification job that manages primary and trial certificate verification processes, compares results, and reports outcomes.

classes.name: TrialComparisonCertVerifier::Job::Request
classes.description: Represents a verification request issued to a Job, managing client callback and coordination with the Job.

classes.name: TrialComparisonCertVerifier
classes.description: Main class implementing certificate verification with trial comparison, managing multiple jobs, configuration, and observers.

methods.name: Job::Start
methods.description: Initiates the verification process, starting primary verification and setting up callbacks.

methods.name: Job::OnPrimaryJobCompleted
methods.description: Handles completion of primary verification, proceeds with trial verification if applicable.

methods.name: Job::OnTrialJobCompleted
methods.description: Handles completion of trial verification, compares results, and determines success or failure.

methods.name: Job::Finish
methods.description: Finalizes the job, reports results, and cleans up.

methods.name: Verify
methods.description: Main method to perform certificate verification, either directly or via a trial job.

methods.name: SetConfig
methods.description: Updates the verifier configuration and propagates changes.

methods.name: AddObserver
methods.description: Adds an observer for verifier events.
